
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/Hpp918039/p/19078231" title="发布于 2025-09-07 16:07">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">01-右键菜单添加删除工具</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>add-右键菜单添加工具</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@echo off &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">title 右键菜单添加工具

REM set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rootMenu=HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rootMenu=HKCR</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
REM set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key=*\shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                       REM 文件右键菜单
REM set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key=Directory\shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">               REM 文件夹右键菜单
REM set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key=DesktopBackground\shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">       REM 桌面右键菜单
set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key=Directory\background\shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    REM 背景右键菜单，包含桌面右键菜单

set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">menuName=menuName1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cmd=cmd.exe /c \"echo hello\"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">icon=%SystemRoot%\system32\imageres.dll,-5362</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> REM 索引与导出文件的索引保持一致即可使用对应ico

reg add </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%rootMenu%\%key%\%menuName%</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /d <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%menuName%</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f
reg add </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%rootMenu%\%key%\%menuName%\command</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /d <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%cmd%</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f
reg add </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%rootMenu%\%key%\%menuName%</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /v <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Icon</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /d <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%icon%</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> 菜单添加成功</pre>
</div>
<p>del-右键菜单添加工具</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>@echo off &amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">title 右键菜单添加工具

REM set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rootMenu=HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rootMenu=HKCR</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
REM set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key=*\shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">                       REM 文件右键菜单
REM set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key=Directory\shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">               REM 文件夹右键菜单
REM set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key=DesktopBackground\shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">       REM 桌面右键菜单
set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key=Directory\background\shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    REM 背景右键菜单，包含桌面右键菜单
set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">menuName=menuName1</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

call :DelRegByQueryResult </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%rootMenu%\%key%\%menuName%</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

pause
exit </span>/<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">b

:DelRegByQueryResult
reg query </span>%<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> &gt;nul <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> %errorlevel% == <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> 注册表 %<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 存在，准备删除...
    reg delete </span>%<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> 注册表 %<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 已删除。
) </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> 注册表 %<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 不存在，无需删除。
)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.
goto :eof</span></pre>
</div>
<p>add-文件夹背景背景右键菜单添加</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion

REM 以管理员权限运行此脚本
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> not <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%~nx0</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>==<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">%~n0.bat</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> 请以管理员身份运行此脚本 &amp;&amp; pause &amp;&amp; exit /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">b)

set filepath</span>=%~<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dp0bin\
pushd </span>%~<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dp0bin

:: 设置注册表路径
set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">reg_path=HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\Directory\background\shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key_prefix=RightMenu_</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> /f <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">delims=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> %%a <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dir /a-d/b *.bat</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> not %%a == %~<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">nx0 (
        set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">name=%%a</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key_name_in_menu=!name:~0,-4!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key_name_in_reg=!key_prefix!!key_name_in_menu!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">exe_path=%%~fa</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        REM 请注意，注册表编辑器（reg.exe）在路径中不支持通配符或某些特殊字符，确保您的变量值符合这些要求。
        REM </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.创建键key
        REM </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>.创建键key的命令，由于你设置的是文件夹背景的右键菜单项，%<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 将代表用户右键点击的文件夹的路径
        reg add </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">!reg_path!\!key_name_in_reg!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /T REG_SZ /d <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">!key_name_in_menu!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f
        reg add </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">!reg_path!\!key_name_in_reg!\Command</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /T REG_SZ /d <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">!exe_path! !filepath!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        REM reg add </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">!reg_path!\!key_name_in_reg!\Command</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /T REG_SZ /d <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">\"!exe_path!\" \"%1\"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> /f &gt;nul <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>&gt;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> Added background menu <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> !name!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    )
)

REM 在注册表中启用长路径支持，允许使用超过260个字符的路径
reg add HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Control\FileSystem </span>/T REG_DWORD /v LongPathsEnabled /d <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span> /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f
popd

timeout </span>/t <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">nobreak
exit </span>/b</pre>
</div>
<p>del-文件夹背景背景右键菜单添加</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@echo off
setlocal enabledelayedexpansion
pushd </span>%~<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">dp0bin

:: 设置注册表路径
set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">reg_path=HKLM\SOFTWARE\Classes\Directory\background\shell</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
set </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">key_prefix=ZhhRightMenu_</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>

<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> /f <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">delims=</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> %%a <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> (<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">dir /a-d/b *.bat</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> not %%a == %~<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">nx0 (
        set name</span>=%%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">a
        set key_name_in_reg</span>=!key_prefix!!name:~<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>,-<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        reg delete </span>!reg_path!\!key_name_in_reg! /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">echo</span> Delete key: !key_name_in_reg!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    )
)

REM 删除长路径支持设置（可选）
reg delete HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SYSTEM\ControlSet001\Control\FileSystem </span>/v LongPathsEnabled /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">f
popd

timeout </span>/t <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span> /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">nobreak
exit </span>/b</pre>
</div>
